description_en: Queries the execution status and result of a video task by calling the GetVideoTask operation
description_zh: 调用GetVideoTask接口查询视频任务的执行状态和结果
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-video-task --project immvideotest --task-type CompressVideoTask --task-id CompressVideoTask-c091c3f5-e6a5-46ce-a0f2-454bd779 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVideoTask

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

CompressVideoTask: video compression task.

GrabFrameTask: video frame capture task
parameters.help_zh:
任务的类型，包含如下选项：

CompressVideoTask：视频压缩任务。

GrabFrameTask：视频截帧任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The task ID. The task ID must correspond to the task type.

This parameter is the Task ID returned after you call the CreateVideoCompressTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144048.html) or CreateGrabFrameTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199047.html) operation
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。设置的任务ID必须与任务类型相对应。

此参数为调用CreateVideoCompressTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144048.html)或CreateGrabFrameTask (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199047.html)接口后返回的Task ID
parameters.name: task_id
